facts.fact: The Home Affairs PS (Prime Minister's Office) and Thales present the new Mauritian eID card as carrying a digital certificate for online authentication and eSignature.

MUS.note: No civil register link to the ID stated.
Wallet holds a birth certificate credential only; no civil register system stated.
Names Digital Mauritius 2030 Strategy in a slide but states no adoption, text or reporting.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: The presenters describe an end-to-end ID system in which citizens register, biographic and biometric data are captured and a new eID card is produced and personalised.
facts.system: Mauritius eID card and Identity Management System

MUS.note: Verifier app described but no service relying on the ID is named.
